chapter: Jack Carey, Red Allen and repertoire
title: Allen's unlucky cap and his hard brass-band music
summary: Happy tells of Allen's cap, the good times together, and the hard music he brought to his band.

So you were with him almost to the end, huh?

Over in there? Yeah. We had some fun. Allen used to come over when we wasn't playing. I had the car living up on who's in there and everything. He used to, I used to drink the wine too. So one, one more man in front of him. I said, who is that? Me. He's brown law. I said, come on in. I said, come on in. I'll get some out and we'll talk. We'll have some fun. I said, all right. I said, well let's get through. Put some clothes on. I got through. I got through. Put some clothes. And me and them got in the car. And me and them went. And the next year we had that. I was like, I'm going to get out. I was like, I'm going to get out. And I was like, I'm going to get out. And I was like, I'm going to get out. I'll get out. I said, you're the old man, you know, I mean he doesn't have a good time. And you know, you're even fired me. Well he'd fire anybody and go high more. But he would have a good band there. And had some of the harder music, harder music and couldn't play it. He wouldn't hear that. He would have an admission. But he'd put his hand in that sack. And the thing that hand would fall on, he'd give it out. And Allen had some of the hardest brass band music. He'd make the music of any band. I don't know where I looked at him either. But he always would get me in the play. Like Peter Boca or Narendra Teoh or Allen Godun. And he used to have a song he made up, Old Lord and Cripple. The boy that he started when they played that. I said, man, you should have been really tight. He used to get so hard. And I used to see him and say, oh Lord I'm crippling. I know that I see you. I said, man, I can't say oh Lord I'm crippling. I couldn't be crippling. I'm crippling. And then I started to walk. I was going to be an island fire juice. I was going to be an island fire juice. I was going to be more than any boss I would have. But he was a good old man.
I used to enjoy hearing him. I guess I heard you play with him but I forgot. Yeah.
